project_context.theme_preference: Dark mode futurista com efeitos neon, glitch e partículas

theme_and_archetype.e1_twist: Black-on-Black layers to ground the neon. Avoid muddy grays. The UI must feel like a high-end command terminal, mixing raw brutalist geometry with delicate, piercing neon accents. No generic purple gradients.

hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase text-white

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Prioritize asymmetry. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8, and col-span-full blocks. Leave strategic negative space.
layout_and_spacing.card_surfaces: 1px solid border-[#1A1A24] bg-[#0C0C10]/80 backdrop-blur-md. Hover states must lift and trigger neon border glow (border-[#00F0FF]/50).

glitch_effect.css_technique: text-shadow with #00F0FF and #FF003C offsets, mixed with clip-path animations. Keyframes switching fast to simulate digital artifacting.

particles.config: Minimalist tiny cyan and white dots floating slowly in the background of the Hero and Skills sections. Must not overwhelm content.

custom_cursor.behavior: A small white dot that follows the mouse, expanding to a larger bordered circle with mix-blend-mode: difference when hovering over interactive elements.

marquee.usage: Massive outlined text (text-8xl, transparent text, 1px white/cyan stroke) scrolling slowly behind the Skills or Projects section to add 'Kinetic Texture'.

scroll_animations.behavior: Elements fade in and translate up (y: 20 -> 0) sequentially using staggerChildren on scroll. Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.

header.layout: Fixed top, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030305]/70 border-b border-[#1A1A24].
header.content: Logo (JF or `<Juan/>`), Desktop Navigation Links, Language Toggle (Shadcn DropdownMenu for PT/EN/ES).

hero.layout: 100vh flex flex-col justify-center items-start. Asymmetric split if using photo.
hero.content: Animated 'Hi, I am' terminal text. Developer name with Glitch effect. Role 'Frontend / Full Stack Developer' with blinking cursor. Particles background. Scroll-down indicator.

about.layout: Bento Grid. Left: Developer Photo (monochrome with cyan highlights). Right: Text bio and tech stats.
about.content: Bio outlining IFSP background and São Paulo location. Highlight frontend passion.

skills.layout: Kinetic Marquee background with a foreground grid of glassmorphic pills.
skills.content: ReactJS, Next.js, React Native, Vue, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind, PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Express, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Linux, Git, WebSockets, Jest.

experience.layout: Vertical timeline. The central line is a glowing neon trace.
experience.content: Atmo Digital (06/2022 - Present). Full Stack Dev. Bullet points focusing on Live Streaming, Live Commerce, QR Meal Control. Cards reveal on scroll.

projects.layout: Asymmetrical featured blocks. One massive 'Hero' project, two smaller supporting projects.
projects.content: Project titles, tech stack overlines, hover-to-reveal links/Github.

contact.layout: Massive CTA taking up significant viewport height.
contact.content: Terminal-style prompt 'Run execution: contact.sh'. Button triggering mailto:juanfuks@hotmail.com. Links to LinkedIn and GitHub. Phone: (13) 99111-7406.

developer_photo.usage: About section profile. Filter it to have high contrast, perhaps grayscale with a cyan overlay.

abstract_tech_texture.usage: Use as a background layer with low opacity (10%) and mix-blend-mode: screen behind the hero or CTA section.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

components_strategy.ui_library: Use generic HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Use Shadcn components heavily customized (remove vercel-look) for interactive logic (DropdownMenu for i18n, Dialog, etc.).
components_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons. Keep stroke widths consistent (1.5px to 2px max).
